indications: CERIANNA is indicated for use with positron emission tomography (PET) imaging for the detection of estrogen receptor (ER)-positive lesions as an adjunct to biopsy in patients with recurrent or metastatic breast cancer.
contraindications: Recommended dose is 222 MBq (6 mCi), with a range of 111 MBq to  222 MBq (3 mCi to 6 mCi), administered as an intravenous injection over 1 to 2 minutes. ( 2.2 ) Recommended imaging start time is 80 minutes (range 20 minutes to 80 minutes) after drug administration. ( 2.4 ) See full prescribing information for additional preparation, administration, imaging, and radiation dosimetry information. ( 2 )
name: CERIANNA
